name: AbuseIPDB - Windows Logon Events from Blacklisted IPs
description: Correlates AbuseIPDB blacklisted IPs with Windows SecurityEvent logon events (EventID 4624 Success, 4625 Failed, 4648 Explicit Credentials) to detect on-premises authentication from known abusive IP addresses. Focuses on network logons (Type 3) and RDP (Type 10).
query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 50
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID in (4624, 4625, 4648)
| where isnotempty(IpAddress)
| where IpAddress in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on IpAddress
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, Activity, Account, IpAddress, AbuseScore, Country, LogonTypeName, Process
| order by AbuseScore desc, TimeGenerated desc
